files.role: Transparent six-hero ensemble and HistoryRoll / Snake & Ladder scroll
files.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: transparent foreground logo/header for the existing HistoryRoll Android portrait loading screen. Use the attached USER loading-screen image as the visual reference; create ONLY its upper hero ensemble and main parchment logo, without the scenery, board, tagline or loading bar. Match the cheerful polished hand-drawn 2D educational cartoon look, bright clean colors, warm gold scroll shading and dark brown outlines (NOT pixel art, NOT chibi). Exactly six Filipino hero busts above and behind a large golden parchment scroll: back left Lapulapu with long dark hair, red headband, earring and upright spear; back center Andres Bonifacio in white shirt and red neckerchief with one fist raised; back right Jose Rizal in dark formal suit; front left Apolinario Mabini in dark formal suit; front center elderly Melchora Aquino with white-gray hair and cream shawl; front right mustached Antonio Luna in a blue historical military uniform and cap. Keep every face clear and distinct; natural cartoon proportions, friendly resolute Grade-6 appropriate expressions. Green leaves and a golden sunburst behind the busts, all part of this ONE header. Scroll lettering must be exact and legible: 'HistoryRoll' large dark brown/gold outlined serif, below it 'Snake & Ladder' in smaller dark brown serif, one small ivory die on each side of the subtitle. Landscape 3:2 or 1.5:1 canvas, tightly frame the entire ensemble and scroll with only a 2 percent transparent safety margin, no clipped spear or hair. True transparent background. No other words, no tagline, no subject banner, no sky, no scenery, no board, no progress bar, no extra people or badges.

files.role: Philippine-themed sky, nipa hut, stone gate, flag and garden scenery
files.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: background-only scenery for a colorful Filipino educational game's PORTRAIT loading screen, 2:3 portrait canvas. Match the attached generated header's polished 2D cartoon art treatment, clean dark brown outlines, bright blue and fresh green palette, soft warm gold shading. Draw a very bright cyan-blue sky with fluffy white clouds and a few rounded leafy tree canopies framing the upper left/right edges. A simple wooden nipa hut on stilts near the lower-left edge, a small Manila Intramuros/Fort Santiago-inspired stone gate near the lower-right with a Philippine flag (blue above red, white triangle, golden sun and three stars). Green bushes and a cheerful grassy garden foreground, distant soft hills; no modern buildings. IMPORTANT COMPOSITION: the central upper 55 percent is mostly open blue sky for a SEPARATE LARGE HERO LOGO overlay; center lower 45 percent is mostly simple clear green lawn for a SEPARATE winding board overlay, so keep landmarks and props at the outer sides, not the center. A small hourglass on a stone plinth at extreme lower-left, small scroll and compass along the bottom-left edge, one ivory die and two closed books at extreme bottom-right. Keep bottom-center 7 percent clear lawn for a real loading bar added later in Godot. A little colorful garden foliage and small pink flowers at corners are okay. No board, no road, no tiles, no text, no logos, no people or portraits, no banner, no progress bar or frame, no UI buttons. It is only the background layer; do not reproduce any part of the header reference.

files.role: Transparent five-lane blank winding path, two snakes, two ladders and START sign
files.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE transparent decorative Snakes and Ladders board illustration for the LOWER part of a mobile HistoryRoll loading screen. Polished bright 2D cartoon illustration with clean warm-brown outlines, matching a cheerful Philippine educational game. This is a wide shallow 3/4-perspective winding ribbon board, not a square grid: FIVE separate horizontal switchback lanes, connected with smooth U-turn bends alternately on right and left; the path starts at BOTTOM LEFT and ends at TOP RIGHT. Exactly SIX broad blank red-and-ivory alternating square/trapezoid tiles on each horizontal lane, FIVE lanes and THIRTY blank tiles in total. Topmost lane recedes slightly in perspective, bottommost lane is closest; pale stone curb edging, small vivid green grass gaps visible BETWEEN the lanes. Keep cells large, broad and clearly separated. IMPORTANT: leave ALL tile faces completely BLANK, with absolutely NO numbers, letters, symbols or question marks on them; the game will render the correct sequential numbers later. One small wood sign saying exactly 'START' outside the bottom-left entrance. Add two friendly bright green cartoon snakes with distinct single heads, yellow bellies and small red tongues connecting distant lanes, and two honey-gold wooden ladders diagonally bridging lanes, like a genuine playful snakes-and-ladders board. Place the snake/ladder artwork near connecting bends and keep the center of every straight tile as unobstructed as possible for later text. Snakes must have continuous anatomically coherent bodies, no extra heads or separate arrowhead tails. The route is the only composition: no trees, hut, buildings, people, titles, dice, books, loading bar or extra scenery. TIGHTLY frame the complete board inside a landscape 3:2 canvas with true transparent background and a very small safety margin; do not clip the START sign, snakes or curb. Warm cream, coral-red, light stone, green snakes and golden ladders, clean soft shadows only immediately under the board. No numbers anywhere.
files.final_edit_prompt: EDIT this transparent winding board. Correct its structure: it currently has only FOUR horizontal lanes; the final board MUST have exactly FIVE horizontal lanes, with SIX BLANK red/cream tile faces in EACH lane (30 blank cells). Add one whole extra lane and its connecting U-turn, not extra columns. Count the FIVE horizontal rows from TOP to BOTTOM at approximately y=12%, 30%, 48%, 66%, 84% of the canvas. Keep a SINGLE continuous serpentine ribbon path starting at bottom-left and ending at top-right, with alternate right and left U-turns connecting adjacent rows. Make every lane a little shorter vertically to fit all FIVE rows within this same landscape canvas. Exactly 6 broad blank tiles across each row; no extra blank tile divisions on the U-turns. Preserve cheerful polished 2D cartoon treatment, alternating coral-red/cream faces, light stone curbs, green grassy gaps, TWO friendly green snakes with single coherent bodies and TWO golden wooden ladders. Keep centers of tiles unobscured for later numbers. Keep the small START sign outside bottom-left; no other text, numbers, icons or scenery. Output must have true TRANSPARENT alpha everywhere outside the board, grass gaps and sign, with no colored rectangle or dark matte; only a very short soft shadow immediately below stone edges. Tight composition, don't clip any board edge. The critical correction is FIVE ROWS, SIX CELLS PER ROW.
files.review_note: First generation had four rows; the final edited asset has five rows / six cells per row. Tile numbers are drawn from 1 to 30 by the existing Explorers node's new splash_board_art.gd script.
